editorial.blurb: Chez Adele is a North Park culinary gem where West African flavors meet American comfort food, all prepared with care by the owner in an open kitchen.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead if you want the beef ribs—they're only served on certain days as part of the specialty menu, and they're worth planning for.
